split_policy: Keep scenario families and close paraphrases in one split. Held-out examples must not be used to author or tune interpretation rules.
provenance_policy: Label synthetic examples explicitly. Include observed user failures only after privacy review and de-identification.
notes: The 10 pilot records, 38 batch-001 records, and 58 batch-002 records are draft development material, not validated ground truth or a performance benchmark.
No validation or held-out split exists yet; do not use corpus scores as release gates.
Batch 002 broadens compositional coverage across cross-domain sequencing, quoted commands, conditional actions, corrections, uncertainty, references, and non-action boundaries.
Domains are descriptive tags; capabilities are cross-domain.
Runtime must not use this corpus as a nearest-sentence lookup table.
Annotation-status counts are reported separately from example/split counts.
Before moving records into validation or held_out, review labels independently and keep each family_id wholly within one split.
